email.subject: Alarm stuck INSUFFICIENT_DATA — outage?
email.body:
Alarm has said INSUFFICIENT_DATA for an hour.

WHAT HAPPENED
I think we are down because the alarm is not OK.

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO
1. Open CloudWatch, Alarms, payments-metric-gap.
2. Read the state and the description.

DO NOT
Do not declare an outage from this alarm alone.

REPLY WITH
INSUFFICIENT_DATA means the metric is missing, not that customers are down. Say you would check whether the instance is still publishing metrics.

— Meera

steps.instruction: Explain INSUFFICIENT_DATA ≠ outage (stopped instance / missing metrics).

reply.model_reply: INSUFFICIENT_DATA means metrics aren't arriving (often stopped instance) — not automatically an outage. Checking publishers next. — L1

debrief.english: Know alarm states: OK / ALARM / INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
